paragraphs: CyberLock, Inc. sells a key-centric electronic access control system meant to increase security, accountability and key control across an organization. Its electronic cylinders retrofit into existing door hardware without power or wiring.

Because the wire between the lock and the managing software is eliminated, locks can be installed almost anywhere. The company describes the result as the convenience of a mechanical key system plus the access permission and tracking of an electronic one. Key control cabinets automatically program and dispense the smart keys. A patented FlashLock option provides keyless access control from a smartphone, tablet or iPad.

Stated uses include airports, where the system can secure hangars, perimeter and interior gates, baggage and restricted areas. Water and power utilities are another, covering substations, reservoirs, equipment and storage areas. Corporate uses listed run to classrooms, computer carts and employee and student files. The news section reports that the CyberKey Blue 4 and Dynamic Audit Events both received Security Today's 2026 Government Security Awards.

quote.text: CyberLock is a key-centric access control system designed to increase security, accountability, and key control throughout your organization.
